description: This file declares the API functions related to CCSP SNMP agent, including initialization, shutdown, parameter get/set, and management of component instances. It serves as a header file defining interfaces for SNMP-related interactions in a CCSP environment.

methods.name: Cosa_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the SNMP agent component.

methods.name: Cosa_FindDestComp
methods.description: Finds the destination component by namespace, returning component name and path.

methods.name: Cosa_GetParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from a specified component and path.

methods.name: Cosa_SetParamValuesNoCommit
methods.description: Sets parameter values without committing the changes immediately.

methods.name: Cosa_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits or rolls back parameter changes.

methods.name: Cosa_GetInstanceNums
methods.description: Retrieves instance numbers of a specific object.

methods.name: Cosa_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry into a specified table.

methods.name: Cosa_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an entry specified by name.

methods.name: Cosa_FreeParamValues
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for parameter values.

methods.name: Cosa_BackgroundCommit
methods.description: Performs background commit or rollback of parameter changes.
